skill.zifeng_s_custom_skill_tree.ae_asse:
Assembly Overclock (AE craft speed): speeds up machines processing crafting patterns (Molecular Assembler).
Lv1 ×2 / Lv2 ×3 / Lv3 ×4 / Lv4 ×5 (cost 500/1000/2000/4000); progress and power scale together, preserving energy per item.
Cap: each assembler completes at most 1 craft/tick. Global, requires OP; highest enabled level applies.
skill.zifeng_s_custom_skill_tree.ae_cpu_:
Compute Overclock (AE process speed): boosts crafting CPU parallel processing.
Lv1 ×2 / Lv2 ×3 / Lv3 ×4 / Lv4 ×5 (cost 1000/2000/4000/8000); effective parallelism = (native + 1) × multiplier − 1, capped at 4096.
Global, requires OP; highest enabled level applies.
[Scope] Only AE2's own crafting CPUs (Crafting Storage) are supported. Crafting CPUs provided by other mods are unaffected.
skill.zifeng_s_custom_skill_tree.ae_asse:
Grace of the Assembly God: instantly executes crafting patterns without Molecular Assemblers. Processing patterns still require their machines.
Per CPU per tick: Lv1 2 crafts / Lv2 4 / Lv3 8 / Lv4 16. Lv5 completes batches; very large orders resume across ticks within a time budget.
Consumes ingredients and normal CPU dispatch energy, waits when unpowered, and returns containers.
Costs: 2000/4000/8000/16000/32000 points. Global, requires OP; highest enabled level applies. The first activation to level 5 unlocks the advancement of the same name (once per save).
skill.zifeng_s_custom_skill_tree.ae_cpu_:
Grace of the Compute God: run independent jobs on one physical CPU: 2/4/8/16 total CPU slots, dynamically unlimited at level 5. Shared storage is multiplied by 2/4/8/16, unlimited at level 5.
Level 5 also removes co-processor limits for physical and virtual CPUs. Materials, power and processing-machine speed still apply; dispatch resumes within the server time budget.
Select, monitor and cancel each CPU independently. Existing jobs drain after disabling or lowering the skill.
[Scope] Only AE2's own crafting CPUs (Crafting Storage) are supported. Crafting CPUs provided by other mods are unaffected. The first activation to level 5 unlocks the advancement of the same name (once per save).
skill.zifeng_s_custom_skill_tree.ae_divi:
Grace of the Myriad-Machine God: while an AE crafting job is active, every machine being fed by pattern providers along that production line receives extra native work cycles each tick.
Lv1 ×2 / Lv2 ×8 / Lv3 ×16 / Lv4 ×128 / Lv5 ×1024 (cost 1000/5000/10000/50000/100000).
Lv6 Instant (cost 1,000,000): one batch is really crafted by the machines at the Lv5 rate; as soon as that batch's products actually return to the crafting job, every remaining batch of that pattern is settled at once - ingredients are taken straight from the crafting CPU's internal inventory and products are delivered through AE2's native path, with no machines and no power draw. If the probe batch is not verified (about 10s timeout) that pattern is dropped and falls back to the Lv5 rate. Processing patterns only (crafting-table patterns still belong to Grace of the Assembly), and native AE2 crafting CPUs only - third-party CPUs keep the Lv5 rate. Also unlocks the level-6 advancement.
[Condition] Only while this network has an unsuspended crafting job and patterns are actually pushed into machines; it stops immediately when the job finishes, is cancelled or suspended.
[Compatibility] Uses AE2's official pattern-provider and machine interfaces, so any machine that accepts AE patterns is detected automatically with no per-mod support. The machine's own power, output and inventory rules are fully preserved.
Extra cycles per machine are bounded by a server time budget and a hard cap, so slow machines run at the closest achievable multiplier.
Global, requires OP; highest enabled level applies. The first activation to level 5 unlocks the advancement of the same name (once per save).
